sum: Gix Internet Ltd., a technology company, focuses on building AI operations management layer for physical operations. It develops an AI-powered management and orchestration layer for robots, people, and autonomous systems. The platform combines management software with autonomous mobile robots and human couriers to schedule and assign internal deliveries in real time. It is built for last-mile movement inside complex high-traffic facilities, such as hospitals. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Herzliya, Israel.
